# Nepal local-level (municipality) boundaries

Downloaded 2026-11-02 by `code/05_link_pga_to_municipalities.py` from Open Data Nepal (CKAN dataset `nepal-municipalities-wise-geographic-data-shp-geojson-topojson-kml`).
Title: Administrative boundaries geographic data  of 753 municipalities in Nepal.  
Author: Sagar Ghimire  
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (attribution required; share-alike).
Resource URL, size and SHA-256: `boundaries_metadata.json`.

CRS: Transverse Mercator (lon_0 84, k 0.9999, x_0 500000) on Everest 1830 (1937); datum labelled 'unknown' in the .prj; treated as Nepal 1981 (EPSG:6207) with the EPSG Helmert shift to WGS 84. Files are not edited.
